_comment: Copy to config.json and set 'bucket'. config.json is gitignored. NEVER put AWS credentials in this file - the scripts read them from the environment.
_bucket_note: S3 bucket names are global. Use random digits, not initials or a name - Udacity prohibits personal information in AWS resource names.
_model_note: Cross-Region inference profile ID as shown in the console. Claude Sonnet 4.5/4.6 and Amazon Nova 2 Lite also work. Do NOT use Nova Lite v1 or Nova Pro v1 - they fail on tool calls.
